reply_text:
I replied to Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the agreed deadline for the signed order form at Thornbury Cloth Co. is **19 November**.

- **How it got there:** On 14 Oct Marcus posted 21 December in #north-team. That same morning he posted a correction in #north-random saying the date is 19 November and that he'd read the wrong line. I read both channels and found nothing later that changes the date. The brain also has the correction saved.
- **Dana could see it herself:** She's a member of both channels, so passing on Marcus's correction doesn't share anything she couldn't already read. A signing deadline is also an operational fact, not a finance figure.
- **Correction to my earlier reply:** When Marcus posted 21 December, I told him I'd found nothing that said otherwise. That was wrong, because his 19 November correction was already posted. Both his original message and my reply in #north-team still show 21 December. I pointed that out to Dana, but I haven't edited or posted anything else there. Marcus may want to correct his message in #north-team so nobody else picks up the old date.
